hull_geometry: Sharply tapered arrowhead hull with multiple recessed weapon banks along the lateral edges; tiered verticality ending in a cluster of hexagonal engine nozzles
materials_and_finish: A mixture of smooth high-tech alloys and jagged crystalline growths; numerous dual-barrel turret mounts are positioned for 360-degree coverage
design_philosophy: Uses crystalline resonance for power and shielding; gives it a regal yet formidable appearance that sparkles in the light of distant stars
color_scheme: Polished chrome and silver metal plates heavily encrusted with large, faceted purple and blue energy crystals; power cores glow with a brilliant cyan light
distinctive_traits: The integration of natural crystal structures into a metallic hull suggests a highly specialized technological path
